notes: AE notes: mid-market SaaS (portfolio analytics) — heavy multi-turn summarization + support chat + embedding search for docs
Account context: currently on OpenAI; spends ~ $60k/mo on inference. Looking to move to hosted first to validate parity, then sign Dedicated for reserved capacity.
Use-case constraints: p95 latency target < 150ms for 1-2k concurrent chat sessions, throughput target ~200 RPS for embeddings & reranking burst.

POC acceptance criteria: automated regression run over 3k prompts; intent-match drop <= 5% vs baseline; p95 latency <= 150ms; cost-per-token projections show >=20% reduction with Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Technical findings: prompt-parity issues concentrated on stop-token behavior and subtle tokenization differences (GPT tokenization vs Redwood-compiled models). Multi-turn context window handling also caused hallucination drift on long summaries.

Requested features: OpenAI-compat endpoint (compat shim), streaming behavior parity, configurable stop-sequence emulation, canary rollout for dedicated deployment, per-route token cost breakdown in Console.
Quote from VP Eng: 'We can tolerate small style shifts but not changes in critical extraction fields — need deterministic field parity for our downstream pipelines.'
Commercial: interested in 12-month committed Dedicated with burstable headroom. Wants a blended price example for current volume + 30% growth.
Security/legal: require SOC2 + DPA with EU residency option. KMS integration for key management. Audit logs retention 1 year minimum.

Recommended Redwood approach (SE notes): start Hosted POC with OpenAI-compat shim, run evals with Redwood Optimize to tune batching/quant profiles, then propose Dedicated sizing with SLA targets. Provide a small regression harness they can run daily during migration.
Next ops item: deliver technical PRD for compat shim + evaluation scripts, hand off to infra for Dedicated sizing by 2026-02-20.
migration_plan: Phase 1 - Hosted POC: run compatibility tests, record deltas, iterate prompts (30d)
Phase 2 - Eval & Pricing: tune batching/quantization, produce Dedicated capacity proposal (2 weeks)
Phase 3 - Pilot Dedicated: canary traffic 10% -> 50% with rollback policies + regression monitoring (4 weeks)
Phase 4 - Full Cutover: contractual committed capacity + cut-over checklist, legal DPA executed
